title: Overlay moderator status response (PRF-02 slice 5, catalogue module #12, held half only)
description: The overlay-facing projection of held alert deliveries awaiting a moderator, scoped to one channel by the overlay session token. It carries a COUNT and nothing else: no supporter name, message text, amount, delivery id, event id, queue id, payment reference or viewer identifier. There is deliberately no safe-mode field -- safe mode is not the queue-paused flag, it is a separate moderation control that does not exist in the schema and needs its own record and decision. `moderatorStatus` is null when the overlay token is not recognised; a recognised token with nothing held returns heldCount 0.
